Politics · India

PM Modi forgives young protesters who allegedly abused him and his mother

Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated he forgives young protesters who allegedly used abusive language against him and his mother during a demonstration at Jantar Mantar. He described them as "misguided children" who need guidance and correction, not punishment. Modi expressed his desire to show them the "right path." A 15-year-old girl, reportedly booked for the alleged abuse, issued a public apology stating she was influenced by others and was ashamed.
